description: Bawany Air Products Limited is a public limited company incorporated in Pakistan on 16 August 1978 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It produces and trades oxygen gas, dissolved acetylene and nitrogen gas at manufacturing facilities in Hub Industrial Estate, Tehsil Hub, Balochistan, and its registered office is on the R.C.D. Highway at Mouza Pathara in the same district.
headOffice: Khasra No. 52/53, R.C.D. Highway, Mouza Pathara, Tehsil Hub, Lasbella District, Balochistan, Pakistan
